card.name: Machine-translated German-style English text
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in awkward, machine-translated English that follows German word order, such as a quote mark, a dash or a comma inside a clumsy sentence. It fires on many kinds of marked word, so the shared signal is the stilted translated setting.

modes.label: Odd translated phrasing
modes.description: A word inside a stiff, literal translation of German, such as a verb or pronoun in a strangely ordered clause.

modes.label: Punctuation in translated text
modes.description: A quote mark, dash or comma in a translated passage that sets off an explanation or gloss.

modes.description: A word inside a translated science or medical passage.
